info.name: Swiggy Mini Delivery Platform API
info.description:
# Swiggy/Zomato Mini Delivery Platform API Collection

Production-grade Postman collection covering all 4 microservices in the distributed food-delivery platform:

- **User Service (`:8081`)**: Authentication, BCrypt password hashing, stateless JWT issuance, RBAC & Redis sliding-window rate limiting.
- **Catalog Service (`:8082`)**: Restaurant listings, menu catalog management, JPA `@EntityGraph` N+1 prevention & 15-minute Redis caching with `@CacheEvict`.
- **Order Service (`:8083`)**: Order state machine, Redis `SETNX` distributed idempotency, Transactional Outbox pattern, Saga coordination & Resilience4j circuit breakers.
- **Dispatch Service (`:8084`)**: Redis `GEOADD`/`GEOSEARCH` rider geospatial indexing, dual REST/STOMP WebSocket telemetry & Redis Pub/Sub multi-node broadcast.
- **Observability Tier**: Spring Boot Actuator, Micrometer Prometheus metrics, and OpenAPI 3 / Swagger specifications.

### Running this Collection
1. Start Docker dependencies: `docker compose up -d` in `infra/docker/`
2. Start all 4 microservices (`:8081`, `:8082`, `:8083`, `:8084`)
3. Run the requests in folder order (or execute the entire collection with Postman Collection Runner / Newman).
4. Automated test scripts automatically extract and pass `jwt_token`, `user_id`, `owner_id`, `rider_id`, `restaurant_id`, `menu_item_id`, and `order_id` between requests.
